summary: Software engineer shipping production ML forecasting at ExD and building evaluated LLM applications (Lexio, a live cited-RAG app). Strong in Python and TypeScript backends, retrieval and LLM evaluation, and full-stack delivery.

projects.name: PythinQ
projects.stack: FastAPI, React/TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, LightGBM, Optuna, Docker
bullets: Built a 4-grain daily demand-forecasting platform (4.9M sales rows) for a beverage-bottling client that forecast manually in Excel; on a 2025 holdout, material-level WAPE is 36% vs 52% for a 28-day average (one-step-ahead).

Routed by demand shape: Huber LightGBM globally, a quantile model for 27 high-variance Material SKUs, and two-stage occurrence/magnitude models for 10,000+ limited-history series across three grains; Optuna with 7-fold walk-forward.
Implemented a Medallion PostgreSQL store (SQLAlchemy), viewer/analyst/admin RBAC, and a Postgres-backed async worker so ingest, training, and multi-day forecasts run outside the HTTP request.

Added a planner workflow (draft/publish, audited edits, 7-business-day freeze, needs-attention flags) and leakage-safe pandas features with hard-fail checks for missing weather/events, covered by 2,300+ tests (pytest, Ruff, basedpyright).

projects.name: Omnix AI
projects.stack: Django, PostgreSQL, JavaScript, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, xAI
bullets: Built the UI overhaul of a multi-model AI debate app (Django templates, vanilla JavaScript): new stylesheet, 5-step panel-creation wizard, debate-room list, and sidebar.
Defined the roster rules (1 Super Expert plus 3-9 debate experts), added persona management and debate-output normalization, and fixed persona-generation token limits for Anthropic models.

Built a multi-tenant Next.js/PostgreSQL eCommerce platform (isolated storefronts and admin, single-tenant mode, pluggable uploads on local disk or MinIO) with GitHub Actions CI/CD: deploy to dev on every push, manual promotion to staging.

Built and deployed a full-stack app (React, Node.js, MongoDB Atlas) with Docker and GitHub Actions to Docker Hub and Render; converted Django advertisement-marketplace pages to a Django + React (Vite) hybrid.
Built a DGA (Domain Generation Algorithm) detection system using DeepD2V embeddings on 200,000+ domain records, outperforming n-gram and Word2Vec baselines.

projects.name: Lexio, Cited Legal Q&A
projects.stack: Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, pgvector, RAG, Groq, Gemini embeddings, Vercel, Neon, Langfuse
bullets: Rebuilt a university Streamlit/FAISS prototype into a deployed app that answers legal-PDF questions with Groq over Gemini embeddings, citing the exact source page for every claim and refusing when evidence is weak.

Benchmarked vector, keyword and hybrid (RRF) retrieval on 106 gold-page questions with 95% confidence intervals; fixing the keyword ranker lifted its MRR from 0.54 to 0.79 (first 73 questions), and LLM query rewriting raised follow-up retrieval from 7/11 to 11/11.

Built the eval harness and published failures: a cited source is on the gold page in 93% of answers (99/106); caught a citation-parser bug that under-reported grounding; a retrieval regression check runs weekly in GitHub Actions.

Added Google sign-in with per-user documents, direct-to-Blob uploads, rate limits and daily budget guards for free-tier quotas, prompt-injection fencing, and Langfuse tracing (OpenTelemetry); EEA visitors fall back to keyword search to respect Gemini's terms.

projects.name: Rice Quality Check (FYP)
bullets: Built an AI system in a 3-member team to classify 8 Pakistani rice varieties and detect adulteration, reaching 92% average accuracy across 6 fine-tuned models on 10,000+ grain images.
